title: Purdue’s Visionary Voices to feature NobleReach Foundation CEO Arun Gupta
summary_en: Arun Gupta, CEO of the NobleReach Foundation and a national leader in technology, entrepreneurship and public service, will be the featured guest in the next installment of Purdue Engineering’s Visionary Voices.
